given: Tenant A and tenant B each have a meeting running on the same meeting_runtime host, each with its own per-tenant encrypted volume, process, and index.
when: Both meetings issue the identical (tool, args) code_intel call (e.g. get_dependents on 'settings.py') at the same moment, and each Workroom query() runs the isolation triad.
then: The per-meeting cache is keyed on tenant_id so each tenant gets only its own graph result; no graph query, path-traversal arg, or cache read ever surfaces the other tenant's code; the SDK isolation triad blocks any host built-in from reaching the wrong sandbox.
